title: Pisces, keep your name
caption: for the pisces who become whoever they're with

scenes.text: neptune made you part ocean, part rumour.
you hear what people mean, not what they say.
venus is exalted in you. you were made for love.
you love the way a lake loves the sky,
taking on their colour until you lose your own.
but loving someone isn't disappearing into them.
keep a shoreline. keep one thing that's only yours.
and when it ends, let it go out with the tide.
don't swim back every night to check.
the one for you will want you, not your reflection.
you can be all that water and still keep your name.
breathe, pisces. the surface is right here.
